A debt you’ll be glad you paid

Settled doesn’t ban your apps. It makes a deal with you — going over is fine, as long as you pay the time back.

1

Decide how much is enough

Pick how long you're happy to spend on social media in one go — 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes. Your number, your choice.

2

Go over, and the apps close

When your time runs out, a calm screen appears over Instagram, TikTok — whichever apps you chose — and they stay closed until you've paid the extra minutes back.

3

Pay it back with real life

Owe 30 minutes? Read for 30 minutes. Or walk, run, cook, tidy, meditate.

4

Watch it add up

Every minute you pay back is time invested in yourself. Minutes become hours and serve as a reminder of what you can achieve if you put your mind in it.

Owe thirty minutes?
Give thirty back.

Your day, in one screen

What you have spent, what you have paid back, what is planned for the week, and the time you are getting up tomorrow.

Choose who
wakes you.

Mornings with a spine

One alarm, no snooze — you set the time tonight so you can't argue with it at six. Four voices to wake you; you choose who you answer to.

The Villain

“Go on, sleep a little longer. I'll take the day off your hands.”

Wants you to fail, and is lovely about it.

The Friend

“Come on. The first minute is the hard one.”

Kind, patient, entirely on your side.

The Sage

“The morning offers what it offers only once.”

Quiet authority. The disappointment does the work.

The Machine

“Countdown reached zero. Initiate waking up.”

Cold, precise, strangely comforting.

Private by architecture

There is nothing to leak, because nothing leaves.

  • The app collects nothing. No account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking — the app itself has no servers. The only thing this website ever stores is an email address, and only if you give us one.
  • Everything stays on your phone. Your usage, goals, notes and history live in the app's private storage — and die with an uninstall.
